title: Kissed Smoky French Black Beans Confit
description: A smoky and flaky French-inspired confit dish featuring black beans in a rich mother sauce, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. This dish combines the flavors of Provence with the convenience of a one-pot wonder.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soaked and drained black beans, tomato paste, vegetable broth, thyme, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until the beans are tender.
Remove the thyme and bay leaves, then serve the confit hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
